source: Physio assessment 02 Nov 2026 and Move Health app list

exercises.name: Squat with band around knees
exercises.notes: Green band around knees, hip-width, push knees out, shallow depth. Default 3x10. Stop if symptoms aggravate and call physio.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.notes: Bodyweight to start; progress with weighted backpack. Default 3x10. Stop if symptoms aggravate and call physio.

exercises.name: Crab walk with band
exercises.notes: Band just above ankles, soft knees. Default 3x10. Stop if symptoms aggravate and call physio.

exercises.name: Calf raise (double-leg)
exercises.notes: Physio notes: start double-leg. Default 3x10. Stop if symptoms aggravate and call physio.

exercises.name: Single leg calf raise
exercises.notes: Listed separately in the Move Health app (screenshot 02 Nov 2026); physio notes describe it as a progression once comfortable. Default 3x10. Stop if symptoms aggravate and call physio.

exercises.name: W-row with band
exercises.notes: Standing, palms down, floor anchor or door handle, yellow band to start. Default 3x10. Stop if symptoms aggravate and call physio.

exercises.name: Internal rotation at 45 degrees
exercises.notes: Standing, elbow at 90 degrees, turn in, yellow band to start. Default 3x10. Stop if symptoms aggravate and call physio.

exercises.name: External rotation with band
exercises.notes: Standing, yellow band to start. Default 3x10. Stop if symptoms aggravate and call physio.

exercises.name: Lat pull-down (shoulder-width grip)
exercises.notes: Multi-gym, shoulder-width grip only; never wide grip. Default 3x10. Stop if symptoms aggravate and call physio.

exercises.name: Standing press (band or cable)
exercises.notes: Standing, yellow band to start. Default 3x10. Stop if symptoms aggravate and call physio.

exercises.name: Adduction pull-down (high anchor)
exercises.notes: Standing, high anchor, yellow band to start. Default 3x10. Stop if symptoms aggravate and call physio.

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch (left)
exercises.notes: Hold 20-30s. Lying on back, towel around foot, knee straight. Left tighter (75-80 deg).

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch (right)
exercises.notes: Hold 20-30s. Lying on back, towel around foot, knee straight.

exercises.name: Calf / Achilles stretch (right)
exercises.notes: PRIORITY: right calf tightness likely driving posterior right knee stiffness. ASSUMPTION: physio gave no sets/hold; 2 x 30s mirrors the other stretches. Confirm at the 2-week follow-up.

exercises.name: Glute stretch, figure-4 (left)
exercises.notes: Hold 20-30s. Left glute tight; sciatica-like symptoms reported.

contraindications: Seated knee extension machine is contraindicated (physio, 02 Nov 2026).
Wide-grip lat pull-down is contraindicated; shoulder-width grip only.
Deep knee flexion under load is contraindicated; keep squats shallow.
stop_rule: Stop any exercise that aggravates your right knee (back of the knee), left glute/sciatic symptoms or shoulders, and call your clinician (Move Health) rather than waiting for the follow-up.
